segments.ja477:1.1: Na te kaṭṭhāni bhinnāni, na te udakamābhataṃ;
segments.ja477:1.3: Aggīpi te na hāpito [hāsito (sī. syā.)], kiṃ nu mandova jhāyasi.
segments.ja477:2.1: Na ussahe vane vatthuṃ, kassapāmantayāmi taṃ;
segments.ja477:2.3: Dukkho vāso araññasmiṃ, raṭṭhaṃ icchāmi gantave.
segments.ja477:3.1: Yathā ahaṃ ito gantvā, yasmiṃ janapade vasaṃ;
segments.ja477:3.3: Ācāraṃ brahme [brahmaṃ (ka.)] sikkheyyaṃ, taṃ dhammaṃ anusāsa maṃ.
segments.ja477:4.3: Raṭṭhe rocayase vāsaṃ, taṃ dhammaṃ nisāmehi me.
segments.ja477:5.1: Visaṃ mā paṭisevittho [paṭisevittha (syā. ka.)], papātaṃ parivajjaya;
segments.ja477:5.3: Paṅke ca mā visīdittho [paṅko ca mā visiyittho (ka.)], yatto cāsīvise care.
segments.ja477:6.1: Kiṃ nu visaṃ papāto vā, paṅko vā brahmacārinaṃ;
segments.ja477:6.3: Kaṃ tvaṃ āsīvisaṃ brūsi, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito;
segments.ja477:7.1: Āsavo tāta lokasmiṃ, surā nāma pavuccati;
segments.ja477:7.3: Manuñño [manuññā (sī. syā. pī.)] surabhī vaggu, sādu [madhu (sī. syā.)] khuddarasūpamo [rasūpamā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja477:7.5: Visaṃ tadāhu ariyā se, brahmacariyassa nārada.
segments.ja477:8.1: Itthiyo tāta lokasmiṃ, pamattaṃ pamathenti tā;
segments.ja477:8.3: Haranti yuvino cittaṃ, tūlaṃ bhaṭṭhaṃva māluto;
segments.ja477:9.1: Lābho siloko sakkāro, pūjā parakulesu ca;
segments.ja477:9.3: Paṅko eso ca [esova (sī. syā. pī.)] akkhāto, brahmacariyassa nārada.
segments.ja477:10.1: Sasatthā [mahantā (syā. ka.)] tāta rājāno, āvasanti mahiṃ imaṃ;
segments.ja477:10.3: Te tādise manussinde, mahante tāta nārada.
segments.ja477:11.1: Issarānaṃ adhipatīnaṃ, na tesaṃ pādato care;
segments.ja477:11.3: Āsīvisoti [āsīviso so (sī. pī.)] akkhāto, brahmacariyassa nārada.
segments.ja477:12.1: Bhattattho bhattakāle ca [yaṃ (sī. pī.)], yaṃ gehamupasaṅkame;
segments.ja477:12.3: Yadettha kusalaṃ jaññā, tattha ghāsesanaṃ care.
segments.ja477:13.1: Pavisitvā parakulaṃ, pānatthaṃ [pānattho (syā. pī.)] bhojanāya vā;
segments.ja477:13.3: Mitaṃ khāde mitaṃ bhuñje, na ca rūpe manaṃ kare.
segments.ja477:14.1: Goṭṭhaṃ majjaṃ kirāṭañca [kirāsañca (sī. syā.), kirāsaṃ vā (pī.)], sabhā nikiraṇāni ca;

lines: Tattha aggīpi te na hāpitoti aggipi te na jālito.
So pitu kathaṃ sutvā uṭṭhāya pitaraṃ vanditvā gāraveneva araññavāse anussāhaṃ pavedento gāthādvayamāha –
Dukkho vāso araññamhi, raṭṭhaṃ icchāmi gantave.
“Yathā ahaṃ ito gantvā, yasmiṃ janapade vasaṃ;
Ācāraṃ brahme sikkheyyaṃ, taṃ dhammaṃ anusāsa man”ti.
Ācāranti yasmiṃ janapade vasāmi, tattha vasanto yathā ācāraṃ janapadacārittaṃ sikkheyyaṃ jāneyyaṃ, taṃ dhammaṃ anusāsa ovadāhīti vadati.
Mahāsatto “sādhu, tāta, desacārittaṃ te kathessāmī”ti vatvā gāthādvayamāha –
Raṭṭhe rocayase vāsaṃ, taṃ dhammaṃ nisāmehi me.
Paṅke ca mā visīdittho, yatto cāsīvise care”ti.
Tattha dhammanti sace raṭṭhavāsaṃ rocesi, tena hi tvaṃ janapadacārittaṃ dhammaṃ nisāmehi.
Yatto cāsīviseti āsīvisassa santike yatto paṭiyatto careyyāsi, sakkonto āsīvisaṃ parivajjeyyāsīti attho.
Tāpasakumāro saṃkhittena bhāsitassa atthaṃ ajānanto pucchi –
“Kiṃ nu visaṃ papāto vā, paṅko vā brahmacārinaṃ;
Kaṃ tvaṃ āsīvisaṃ brūsi, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito”ti.
Visaṃ tadāhu ariyā se, brahmacariyassa nārada.
Haranti yuvino cittaṃ, tūlaṃ bhaṭṭhaṃva māluto;
Paṅko eso ca akkhāto, brahmacariyassa nārada.
Te tādise manussinde, mahante tāta nārada.
Yadettha kusalaṃ jaññā, tattha ghāsesanaṃ care.
Mitaṃ khāde mitaṃ bhuñje, na ca rūpe manaṃ kare.
Visaṃ tadāhūti taṃ āsavasaṅkhātaṃ suraṃ ariyā “brahmacariyassa visan”ti vadanti.
Na tesaṃ pādato careti tesaṃ santike na care, rājakulūpako na bhaveyyāsīti attho.
Rājāno hi āsīvisā viya muhutteneva kujjhitvā anayabyasanaṃ pāpenti.
Yadettha kusalanti yaṃ tesu upasaṅkamitabbesu gehesu kusalaṃ anavajjaṃ pañcaagocararahitaṃ jāneyyāsi, tattha ghāsesanaṃ careyyāsīti attho.
Na ca rūpe manaṃ kareti parakule mattaññū hutvā bhojanaṃ bhuñjantopi tattha itthirūpe manaṃ mā kareyyāsi, mā cakkhuṃ ummīletvā itthirūpe nimittaṃ gaṇheyyāsīti vadati.
Goṭṭhaṃ majjaṃ kirāṭanti ayaṃ potthakesu pāṭho, aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana “goṭṭhaṃ majjaṃ kirāsañcā”ti vatvā “goṭṭhanti gunnaṃ ṭhitaṭṭhānaṃ.
Sabhā nikiraṇāni cāti sabhāyo ca hiraññasuvaṇṇānaṃ nikiraṇaṭṭhānāni ca.
